title: Minecraft Client
description: Everything HMC-Prometheus exports for a single Minecraft client.

targets.expr: max by (client, server) (label_replace(hmc_server_address_info{client="$client"}, "server", "$1", "value", "(.*)")) or max by (client, server) (label_replace(hmc_server_singleplayer{client="$client"} == 1, "server", "Singleplayer", "client", ".*"))

panels.title: Main thread latency
panels.description: Time until Minecraft's main thread ran a scheduled task. High values mean the game is stuck.

panels.title: Screen
panels.description: The latest screenshot of the client, reloaded with every dashboard refresh, loaded by your browser directly from the client. For a live view open http://${instance}/live. Only works if the game renders, e.g. with a display or Xvfb, not in HeadlessMc's headless mode.

panels.title: Console

options.content: <iframe src="http://${instance}/console" width="100%" height="100%" frameborder="0" title="hmc-specifics console"></iframe>

panels.description: Executes hmc-specifics commands on the client, also commands of other mods, e.g. Baritone. The command and its output appear in the log above, after the next refresh. Needs console=true in the HMC-Prometheus config of the client: prometheus set console true

panels.title: Log
panels.description: The game log, including chat with colors and the commands of the console with their output. Needs lokiUrl in the HMC-Prometheus config.

panels.title: Client tick time
panels.description: Milliseconds per client tick over the last 100 ticks. Above 50 ms the client cannot keep up with 20 ticks per second.

panels.title: Main thread
panels.description: Latency: time until the main thread ran the collection. Data age: greater than 0 if the main thread did not collect in time and old values were served.

panels.title: Time since last packet
panels.description: Milliseconds since the last packet from the server. Grows if the connection is stuck.

panels.title: Day time
panels.description: Ticks since sunrise, 6000 is noon, 18000 is midnight.

panels.title: GC time
panels.description: Fraction of time spent in garbage collection.
